/itinerary_variants/1/stops/5/highlights.source_en: **Jeseong Bakery octopus buns** — local cult favorite, queues by 10:00
**Hallabong + cheonhyehyang citrus** in season (Dec–Mar) — Jeju mandarin hybrids
Hairtail (galchi) sashimi, black pork skewers, Mom-guk (Jeju seaweed soup)
**Translucent retractable roof** — covered arcade, weather-proof shopping
**5-min walk to ⟦G0⟧ trailhead** — natural lunch + stroll pairing

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/5/whyOnRoute.source_en: **A short ⟦G0⟧ stop gives guests time for local snacks and small gifts before returning to Gangjeong Port.** The market is close to the terminal, so it can be included without creating a risky long-distance return. The guide helps set a clear meeting point and time so the group can browse comfortably and still return to the ship with buffer.

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/5/descriptio.source_en: **Seogwipo Maeil Olle Market (서귀포매일올레시장)** is the largest traditional market in Seogwipo and a convenient food-and-shopping stop near Gangjeong Port. The market began in the early 1960s and now stretches through a covered arcade with many local food stalls, produce shops, seafood vendors, bakeries, and souvenir stands. Guests can look for Jeju citrus, black pork snacks, seafood, omegi rice cakes, local sweets, and simple gifts to take back to the ship. Most visitors enjoy it as a lively local-market walk rather than a formal shopping stop. Payment methods vary by stall, so carrying some Korean won is still recommended even though many larger shops accept cards.

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/6/name.source_en: Return to Gangjeong Cruise Terminal (Seogwipo — south)

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/6/highlights.source_en: **Drop-off 60+ min before all-aboard time** — cruise industry standard
From Olle Market / Cheonjiyeon area: ~10–15 min drive (port-side circuit)
From Hallasan 1100: ~35 min descent via Route 1100
Driver/guide luggage assistance at terminal entrance
**Limousine Bus 800 / 800-1** connects Gangjeong-area → Jeju Airport via Innovation City
Tourist info center, currency exchange, tax-refund counter on-site

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/6/whyOnRoute.source_en: **The south route has a naturally efficient return to Gangjeong Port.** ⟦G0⟧ and central Seogwipo are close to the terminal, so the final transfer is usually short. This gives the tour more room for the main stops while still keeping a careful return buffer before all-aboard.

/itinerary_variants/1/stops/6/descriptio.source_en: Return drive to the **Gangjeong Port Cruise Terminal** in Seogwipo's Gangjeong Village. From the southern circuit around ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G0⟧, and downtown Seogwipo, the drive is usually short, often around 10–15 minutes by local roads. The schedule is planned to bring guests back well before the ship's all-aboard time, with extra room for traffic, restroom use, and boarding procedures. Your guide confirms the ship schedule during the day and adjusts the pace if road or weather conditions require it.
